question: In the MSK-IMPACT sarcoma cohort (Nacev et al.), what fraction of intimal sarcomas harbored oncogenic TERT amplifications?
gold_notes: 44% (8/18) of intimal sarcomas had oncogenic TERT amplifications.

Now let me read the specific paper page to get the precise figure:Perfect! I have the exact answer. According to [Nacev et al.'s MSK-IMPACT sarcoma study](papers/35705560.html):

**In the MSK-IMPACT sarcoma cohort (n=18 intimal sarcomas), 44% (8/18) of intimal sarcomas harbored oncogenic [TERT](genes/TERT.html) amplifications.**

This finding was notably distinct from the classical MDM2/CDK4 amplicon seen in liposarcomas, and the TERT amplifications in intimal sarcomas were functionally distinct from TERT promoter mutations observed in other sarcoma types like myxoid round-cell liposarcoma (MRLS), solitary fibrous tumor (SFT), and dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma (DDCHS).
